text:
I am in dread.

what I most feared has come over me.

I am not in difficulty:

I am at the end of my strength.


I did not abandon the void and the desert.

I live in danger.


your song does not help me.

more and more pincers,

more fears,

more black shadows.

translation.title: I Am in Dread...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the lowercase pressure and the escalation from difficulty to exhaustion.
